Two-Factor Authentication (TOTP)

To protect your account against password theft, you can use a smartphone or another device for receiving time-based one-time passwords ("TOTP").

If you lose your device, you will be able to use a single-use recovery key to regain access to your account.

Two-Factor Authentication (Security Keys)

Security keys are hardware devices containing cryptographic keys. They can be used for two-factor authentication. Security keys must support the WebAuthn Authenticator standard.

If you lose your security keys, you will lose access to your account. You may want to configure an additional authentication method.
